name: Gem of Pythas
summary: In the Wailing Caverns, Lord Pythas bears one of four corrupted dream gems. Together, the gems feed the nightmare twisting the underground oasis and threaten the Barrens.

sections.title: A Vessel of the Nightmare
sections.body:
Naralex entered the Emerald Dream to restore the arid Barrens. There, his vision became a living nightmare. His foremost followers fell with him and became the Druids of the Fang. Now they seek to remake the surface world as a venomous jungle.

Lord Pythas bears one of four dream gems that anchor the corruption in the caverns. The stone channels the druids’ dark design. It also proves to the druids of Thunder Bluff that Pythas’s twisted trance has been broken.

faq.q: What is the Gem of Pythas used for?
aliases: what to do with gem of pythas
faq.answer: Take the gem to Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff with the gems of Cobrahn, Anacondra, and Serpentis. Together, the four gems complete the work of ending the rogue leaders of the Druids of the Fang.

aliases: where to get gem of pythas
faq.answer: Lord Pythas carries the gem. He is a fallen night elf druid who dwells deep in the Wailing Caverns of the Barrens.

faq.q: Why do the druids of Thunder Bluff want the gem?
faq.answer: The corruption from the Wailing Caverns haunts Nara Wildmane and the Cenarion druids in Thunder Bluff. Securing the gems proves the four aberrant leaders are slain and cuts off the nightmare before it spreads farther into the Barrens.

faq.q: Are there other gems like this one?
faq.answer: Yes. Each of the four leaders carries a dream gem deep in the cavern. The others are Lady Anacondra, Lord Cobrahn, and Lord Serpentis.

angles.text: As a Cenarion druid, recovering the gem is a somber duty. It marks how far Naralex’s inner circle has fallen into serpentine horrors.
As a tauren, you know the twisted rites in the caverns threaten the Barrens’ fragile balance. Recovering these gems is vital to protecting your shamans’ and druids’ homeland.
